methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected from each provider's official pricing page where accessible. Where the official page returned 403/503, was JS-only/empty, or redirected outside of a pricing context, a reputable 2025-2026 pricing-review source was used as primary and noted in provenance. DirecTV Stream was excluded: it was discontinued as a standalone brand on April 13, 2025 and merged into the main DirecTV satellite service. Hulu.com redirects entirely to disneyplus.com and no Hulu-specific pricing page rendered; TVGuide review (Apr 2025) was used as primary for Hulu + Live TV. FuboTV official site returned empty JS-rendered pages; reviews.org (last updated Apr 2026) was used as primary. All prices are recurring monthly USD for the smallest billable unit. HIPAA/BAA are not applicable to consumer live TV streaming and are recorded null. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null for every plan (non-telephony vertical).

vendors.name: YouTube TV
vendors.provenance: https://tv.youtube.com/welcome/ (official YouTube TV pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14; page loaded and returned full pricing data directly)

plans.name: YouTube TV (Standard)
plans.notes: 100+ channels. Unlimited cloud DVR storage. Up to 6 household accounts. 3 simultaneous streams (unlimited with 4K Plus add-on). Includes Disney+ and ESPN+ (with ads) via bundle. No annual billing option published; month-to-month only. Promotional rate of $67.99/mo for first 3 months available through July 31, 2026 for new subscribers.

plans.name: Sports Plan
plans.notes: 30+ channels focused on sports content. Promotional rate of $54.99/mo for first 12 months available through July 31, 2026 for new subscribers. Fewer general entertainment channels than the standard plan.

vendors.name: Hulu + Live TV
vendors.provenance: https://www.hulu.com/ redirects to disneyplus.com (302); no standalone Hulu pricing page rendered. Primary source: https://www.tvguide.com/news/hulu-live-tv-review/ (last updated April 27, 2025). Corroborated by Digital Trends best-live-tv-streaming-services guide (last updated January 26, 2025).

plans.name: Hulu + Live TV (with Ads)
plans.notes: 100+ live TV channels plus full Hulu on-demand library with ads. Includes Disney+ (with ads) and ESPN Select. Unlimited cloud DVR. Up to 2 simultaneous streams (expandable with add-ons). No published annual billing option. Price reflects the Disney price increase effective October 21, 2025 (prior price was $82.99).

plans.name: Hulu (No Ads) + Live TV
plans.notes: Same 100+ live channels as the ad-supported plan but with ad-free on-demand viewing on Hulu and Disney+. Live broadcasts and some on-demand titles still include ads. Includes Disney+ (no ads) and ESPN Select. Price reflects the Disney price increase effective October 21, 2025 (prior price was $95.99).

vendors.name: Sling TV
vendors.provenance: https://www.sling.com/plans returned HTTP 403; https://www.sling.com/ returned HTTP 403. Primary source: https://www.reviews.org/tv-service/sling-tv-review/ (last updated April 9, 2026). Corroborated by Digital Trends best-live-tv-streaming-services guide (last updated January 26, 2025).

plans.name: Sling Select
plans.notes: Entry-level package with a limited channel selection. Primarily local and basic cable channels. Fewer channels than Sling Orange or Sling Blue.

plans.name: Sling Orange
plans.notes: 30+ channels including Disney, ESPN and sports-focused content. Single simultaneous stream only. Includes ESPN, ESPN2, ESPN3, Disney Channel, Freeform.

plans.name: Sling Blue
plans.notes: 40+ channels oriented toward news, dramas, and reality TV. Up to 3 simultaneous streams. Includes Fox, NBC, NBC Sports, NFL Network, Bravo, USA, E!.

plans.name: Sling Orange + Blue
plans.notes: Combined package: 50+ channels covering both Orange and Blue lineups. Up to 3 simultaneous streams. Best value for households wanting both sports and general entertainment coverage.

vendors.name: FuboTV
vendors.provenance: https://www.fubo.tv/ returned empty JS-rendered page; https://www.fubo.tv/stream/plans/ returned HTTP 404. Primary source: https://www.reviews.org/tv-service/fubotv-review/ (last updated April 16, 2026). Corroborated by Digital Trends best-live-tv-streaming-services guide (last updated January 26, 2025). Note: FuboTV merged with Hulu + Live TV under Disney majority ownership in October 2025 but continues operating as a separate brand.

plans.name: Sports + News
plans.notes: Sports-focused skinny bundle launched September 2025 as 'Fubo Sports.' Includes live sports and news channels. Promotional first-month price of $45.99 after free trial. Standard price $55.99/mo thereafter.

plans.name: Latino
plans.notes: Spanish-language focused package with 50+ channels. Price reflects the Fubo Latino monthly increase effective June 2026 (prior price was $14.99).

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 152+ channels with 100+ live sports events in 4K. Unlimited cloud DVR storage. Up to 10 simultaneous streams. Promotional first-month price of $48.99 after free trial.

plans.name: Elite
plans.notes: 218+ channels including all Pro channels plus additional entertainment networks. Unlimited cloud DVR. Up to 10 simultaneous streams. Promotional first-month price of $53.99 after free trial.

vendors.name: Philo
vendors.provenance: https://www.philo.com/ (official Philo homepage, pricing loaded directly, accessed 2026-06-14). Corroborated by reviews.org Philo review (last updated February 24, 2026).

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: 200+ live pay TV and free channels. 75,000+ on-demand titles. 1-year unlimited cloud DVR. No sports (ESPN, Fox Sports, etc.) or local broadcast channels. 7-day free trial for new subscribers.

plans.name: Bundle+
plans.notes: Everything in Essential plus bundled access to HBO Max Basic with Ads, AMC+, discovery+, and All Reality. Expanded on-demand library of 80,000+ titles. Saves approximately $22/mo vs. purchasing included apps separately.

vendors.name: Frndly TV
vendors.provenance: https://www.frndlytv.com/plans (official Frndly TV plans page, pricing loaded directly, accessed 2026-06-14). Site redirects to try.frndlytv.com. Corroborated by try.frndlytv.com homepage which confirms plan names and prices.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: 50+ live channels including A&E, Hallmark Channel, Hallmark Mystery, Hallmark Family, The HISTORY Channel, Lifetime, Game Show Network, Court TV, ION, MeTV, The Weather Channel, and others. Standard definition. 1 simultaneous stream.

plans.name: Classic
plans.notes: Same 50+ channels as Basic. HD streaming. Up to 2 simultaneous streams. Cloud DVR included.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Same 50+ channels as Basic/Classic. HD streaming. Up to 3 simultaneous streams. Unlimited cloud DVR. 7-day free trial available.
